blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: On-device RGB photo enhancement is a popular task that is needed for quality improvement of photos captured with mobile devices as well as for retouching of images acquired through other sources. This creates a need for efficient deep learning models for this problem that are not only performant but can also be deployed on constrained mobile hardware. In this Mobile AI challenge, we address this problem and propose participants to design fast solutions that can perform comprehensive enhancement of RGB photos while running on popular smartphone GPUs from Qualcomm and Arm. For this, the participants were provided with a large-scale DPED dataset consisting of RGB image pairs captured with an old iPhone 3GS smartphone and a professional Canon 70D DSLR camera. The runtime of all models was evaluated on the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 and Dimensity 9500 chipsets with the Adreno and Mali GPUs, respectively. Top solutions proposed in this challenge are able to enhance Full HD resolution RGB images on both platforms under 300 milliseconds. A comprehensive description of the models developed in the challenge is provided in this paper.
blocks.zh: On-device RGB照片增强是一项流行的任务,是改进用移动设备拍摄的照片的质量以及通过其他来源获取的图像进行重新校正所必需的. 这就需要为这一问题建立高效的深层学习模式,这些模式不仅能够发挥作用,而且还可以部署在有限的移动硬件上。 在这项Mobile AI挑战中,我们解决这一问题,并提议参与者设计快速解决方案,在运行来自Qualcomm和Arm的流行智能手机GPU的同时,能够全面增强RGB照片. 为此,向与会者提供了一套大型的DPED数据集,包括用一台旧的iPhone 3GS智能手机和一台专业的Canon 70D DSLR相机捕获的RGB图像对. 所有型号的运行时间在Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5和Dimensity 9500芯片上分别与阿德雷诺和马里GPU进行了评价. 在这项挑战中提出的顶峰解决方案能够增强两个平台上300毫秒以下的全HD分辨率RGB图像. 本文件全面介绍了挑战中开发的模式。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Image restoration and enhancement are fundamental problems in computer vision that aim to improve various aspects of image quality, including denoising, deblurring, super-resolution, color correction, contrast enhancement, dynamic range reconstruction and artifact removal. These research areas have attracted significant attention from the computer vision and graphics communities in recent years due to their broad practical relevance and inherent technical challenges. With the rapid growth of mobile photography, enhancing images captured by compact mobile camera sensors has become an active area of research, driving the development of advanced image enhancement techniques for smartphones and other resource-constrained devices. Tackling this problem as an end-to-end photo enhancement task was first proposed in [ 23 , 24 ] , where the authors presented a deep learning model for mapping low-quality smartphone photos to superior-quality images obtained with a high-end DSLR camera. The collected DPED dataset was later used in a number of subsequent challenges [ 48 , 51 ] and works [ 79 , 66 , 13 , 20 , 19 , 63 ] that proposed numerous performant solutions for this problem. In this competition, we use the same dataset and propose the participants to design even more efficient RGB image enhancement models that can run on recent smartphone GPUs.
blocks.zh: 图像修复和增强是计算机视觉中的根本问题,目的是提高图像质量的方方面面,包括去诺活化,去污,超分辨率,色调校正,对比度增强,动态范围重建以及文物去除等. 近年来,由于这些研究领域具有广泛的实际意义和固有的技术挑战,因此引起了计算机视野和图形界的极大关注。 随着移动摄影的快速发展,强化由紧凑移动相机传感器所捕获的图像成为了活跃的研究领域,推动了智能手机和其他受资源限制设备的先进图像增强技术的发展. 将这个问题作为端到端照片增强任务,首先在[23,24]中提出来,作者提出了将低质量智能手机相片映射到用高端DSLR相机获得的高质量相片的深度学习模型. 所收集的DPED数据集后来被应用于后来的一些挑战[48,51]和为该问题提出了众多实用解决方案的作品[79,66,13,20,19,63]. 在这场比赛中,我们使用相同的数据集,并提议参与者设计更有效率的可以运行在近期智能手机GPU上的RGB图像增强模型.

blocks.en: Designing deep learning models that run efficiently on mobile devices — especially across different AI accelerators like NPUs — is a complex challenge. It demands careful analysis of hardware constraints such as limited operator support, restricted memory capacity and bandwidth, reduced accuracy for quantized models and specific driver behavior of NPUs. Even when certain layers or operations are technically supported, they may be executed inefficiently due to constraints related to NPU hardware architecture or its driver implementation, and thus create performance bottlenecks during inference. A striking example here would be the Google Tensor NPU present in all recent Google Pixel smartphones that, despite having quite high theoretical peak performance, is unable to efficiently accelerate the vast majority of even simplistic CNN-based models [ 37 ] . As a result, achieving low latency and energy efficiency often requires partial or complete redesigns of model architectures. For a more detailed discussion of these challenges and the performance of modern mobile AI accelerators we refer to [ 45 , 42 ] . Overall, all these limitations require various adaptations of the standard deep learning models for their efficient deployment on mobile NPUs, including conventional optimizations like 16-bit / 8-bit [ 10 , 54 , 53 , 86 , 61 , 69 , 6 , 73 , 74 , 62 ] and low-bit [ 8 , 78 , 3 , 52 , 65 , 90 , 4 , 56 , 14 , 5 , 59 ] quantization, network pruning and compression [ 10 , 60 , 64 , 70 , 55 , 16 , 89 , 85 , 57 , 81 ] , NPU-specific adaptations, platform-aware neural architecture search [ 18 , 75 , 83 , 80 , 68 , 12 , 88 , 84 , 11 , 87 ] , etc .
blocks.zh: 设计在移动设备上高效运行的深层学习模型——尤其是跨不同AI加速器如NPU——是一个复杂的挑战. 它要求对硬件限制进行仔细分析,例如操作员支持有限,内存容量和带宽有限,量化模型的准确性降低以及NPU的特定驱动行为等. 即使某些地层或操作得到了技术支持,但由于与NPU硬件架构或其驱动程序执行相关的限制,它们也可能被低效地执行,从而在推论过程中产生性能瓶颈. 例如Google Tensor NPU在最近所有Google Pixel智能手机中出现, 尽管理论上的峰值性能相当高, 因此,实现低延迟和能效往往需要部分地或彻底地重新设计模型结构。 关于这些挑战和现代移动AI加速器的性能的更详细讨论,我们提到[45,42]. 总体来说,所有这些限制都需要对标准深层学习模式进行各种调整,才能有效部署在移动式NPU上,包括16位/8位等常规优化[10,54,53,86,61,69,6,73,74,62]和低位[8,78,3,52,65,90,4,56,14,5,59]分量化,网络穿梭和压缩[10,60,64,70,55,16,89,85,57,81],NPU特有改造,平台神经架构搜索[18,75,83,80,68,12,88,84,11,87]等.

blocks.en: In this Mobile AI Challenge, the participants were proposed to develop efficient deep learning models that can enhance Full HD resolution RGB images while running on smartphone GPUs. For this, the participating teams were provided with the DPED dataset [ 23 ] consisting of thousands of paired photos captured with a low-end 3.15MP iPhone camera and a professional Canon 70D DSLR. The runtime of the models was evaluated on mobile GPUs present in the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 and the Dimensity 9500 chipsets. Each submission was evaluated based on both image fidelity and runtime efficiency, thus balancing reconstruction quality with model efficiency. All solutions developed during this challenge are fully compatible with the LiteRT [ 71 ] (former TensorFlow Lite) framework, enabling deployment on a variety of Linux and Android-based IoT platforms, smartphones, and edge devices.
blocks.zh: 在本次"移动AI挑战"中,与会者被提议开发出高效的深层学习模型,可以在智能手机GPU上运行的同时增强全HD分辨率RGB图像. 为此,向各参与小组提供了DPED数据集[23],其中包括用低端3.15MP iPhone相机和一支专业Canon 70D DSLR拍摄的上千对相片. 这些模型的运行时间在Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5和Dimensity 9500芯片中的移动GPU上得到了评价. 每次提交都根据图像真实性和运行时间效率进行了评价,从而平衡了重建质量和模型效率。 在这项挑战期间所开发出的所有解决方案都与LiteRT [71] (前作"TensorFlow Lite")框架完全相容,使得能够在各种Linux和基于Android的IoT平台,智能手机,和边缘设备上部署.

blocks.en: 2 Challenge
blocks.zh: 2 挑战

blocks.en: To design an efficient and practical solution for mobile-related tasks, the following key components are essential:
blocks.zh: 为了为移动相关任务设计一个高效而实际的解决办法,以下关键组成部分至关重要:

blocks.en: 1. A high-quality and large-scale dataset that can be used to train and evaluate the solution; 2. An efficient way to check the runtime and debug the model locally without any constraints;
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 高质量和大规模的数据集,可用于培训和评估解决方案; 2. 高效率地检查运行时间并在当地调试模型而不受任何限制; 4.

blocks.en: A high-quality and large-scale dataset that can be used to train and evaluate the solution;
blocks.zh: 高质量和大规模数据集,可用于培训和评估解决方案;

blocks.en: An efficient way to check the runtime and debug the model locally without any constraints;
blocks.zh: 一种在不受限制的情况下在当地检查运行时间和调试模型的有效方法;

blocks.en: This challenge addresses the above issues. Real training data, tools, and runtime evaluation options provided to the challenge participants are described in the next sections.
blocks.zh: 这一挑战涉及上述问题。 下几节介绍向挑战参与者提供的实际培训数据、工具和运行时间评价备选方案。

blocks.en: 2.1 Dataset
blocks.zh: 2.1 数据集

blocks.en: In this challenge, we use a popular DPED dataset [ 23 ] that consists of photos taken in the wild synchronously by three smartphones and one DSLR camera. In total, the dataset provides over 22K photos, including 4549 photos from Sony smartphone, 5727 from iPhone and 6015 photos from each Canon and BlackBerry cameras. The dataset also provides aligned phone-DSLR paired patches of resolution 100 × \times 100 px for training neural networks. In this challenge, we consider only a subtask of mapping photos from a very old iPhone 3GS device into the photos from Canon 70D DSLR, one such sample photo pair is shown in Fig. 1 .
blocks.zh: 在这项挑战中,我们使用一个受欢迎的DPED数据集[23],由由三台智能手机和一台DSLR相机在野外同步拍摄的照片组成. 数据集总共提供了超过22K相片,包括来自索尼智能手机的4549相片,来自iPhone的5727相片和来自每台Canon和BlackBerry相机的6015相片. 该数据集还提供对齐的手机-DSLR配对补丁的分辨率100×\times 100px用于培训神经网络. 在这项挑战中,我们只考虑将一个很老的iPhone 3GS设备相片映射到Canon 70DDSLR相片中的子任务,图1显示了其中一对相片样本.

blocks.en: 2.2 Local Runtime Evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.2 当地运行时间评价

blocks.en: When developing AI solutions for mobile devices, it is vital to be able to test the designed models and debug all emerging issues locally on available devices. For this, the participants were provided with the AI Benchmark application [ 42 , 45 ] that allows users to load any custom TensorFlow Lite model and run it on any Android device with all supported acceleration options. This tool contains the latest versions of the Qualcomm QNN, MediaTek Neuron, Hexagon NN, TFLite GPU, Android NNAPI, Samsung ENN, Amlogic AML and Arm NN delegates, therefore supporting all current mobile platforms and providing the users with the ability to execute neural networks on smartphone NPUs, APUs, DSPs, GPUs and CPUs.
blocks.zh: 在为移动设备开发AI解决方案时,必须能够测试所设计的模型并调试所有本地现有设备上的新出现问题. 为此,向参与者提供了AI基准应用程序[42,45],允许用户加载任何自定义的TensorFlow Lite模型并运行在任何Android设备上,所有支持的加速选项. 这个工具包含了Qualcomm QNN,MediaTek Neuron,六角NN,TFLite GPU,Android NNAPI,三星ENN,Amlogic AML和Arm NN代表的最新版本,因此支持了所有当前的移动平台,并为用户提供了在智能手机NPU,APU,DSP,GPU和CPU上执行神经网络的能力.

blocks.en: 2.3 Runtime Evaluation on the Target Platform
blocks.zh: 2.3 目标平台运行时间评价

blocks.en: Table 1 : Mobile AI 2026 RGB Image Enhancement challenge results and final rankings. During the runtime measurements, the models were processing photos of resolution 1920 × \times 1088 pixels on the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 and Dimensity 9500 SoCs. Team DaHua-IIG is the challenge winner.
blocks.zh: 表1:移动AI 2026 RGB 图像增强挑战结果和最终排名. 在运行时间测量中,模型处理的是Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5和Dimensity 9500 SoCs上的1920×\times 1088像素相片. DAHA-IIG队是挑战取胜者.

blocks.en: In this challenge, we use two flagship mobile SoCs as our target evaluation platforms: Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 and MediaTek Dimensity 9500 chipsets with the Adreno 840 and Arm Mali G1-Ultra MC12 GPUs, respectively, that can be found in numerous flagship smartphones. The models were parsed and accelerated using the TFLite GPU delegate [ 58 ] that demonstrated the best runtime results on both platforms. NPU runtimes provided for the reference were obtained by running the models with the Qualcomm QNN and MediaTek Neuron TFLite delegates on the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 and the Dimensity 9500 SoCs. All final solutions were tested using the aforementioned AI Benchmark application.
blocks.zh: 在这个挑战中,我们使用两个旗舰移动SoC作为我们的目标评价平台: Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5和MediaTek Dimensity 9500芯片,分别配有Adreno 840和Arm Mali G1-Ultra MC12 GPU,可参见于多部旗舰智能手机. 这些模型使用TFLite GPU代表[58]进行了解析并加速,该代表展示了两个平台上最佳运行时间结果. 与Qualcomm QNN和MediaTek Neuron TFLite代表一起运行Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5和Dimensity 9500 SoCs的模型,获得了为参考提供的NPU运行时间. 所有最终解决方案都利用上述AI基准应用程序进行了测试。

blocks.en: 2.4 Challenge Phases
blocks.zh: 2.4 挑战阶段

blocks.en: The challenge consisted of the following phases:
blocks.zh: 挑战包括以下几个阶段:

blocks.en: I. Development: the participants get access to the data and AI Benchmark app, and are able to train the models and evaluate their runtime locally; II. Validation: the participants can upload their models to the remote server to check the fidelity scores on the validation dataset, and to compare their results on the validation leaderboard; III. Testing: the participants submit their final results, codes, TensorFlow Lite models, and factsheets.
blocks.zh: 我当然知道 I. 开发:参与者可以获得数据和AI基准应用,能够在当地培训模型并评价其运行时间; 二. 验证:参与者可以将其模型上传到远程服务器,检查验证数据集上的忠诚分数,并比较验证领导板上的结果; III. 测试:参与者提交最终结果,代码,TensorFlow Lite模型,以及事实表.

blocks.zh: 验证:参与者可以将其模型上传到远程服务器,以检查验证数据集上的忠诚分数,并比较其在验证领导板上的结果;

blocks.en: Testing: the participants submit their final results, codes, TensorFlow Lite models, and factsheets.
blocks.zh: 测试:参与者提交最终结果,代码,TensorFlow Lite模型,以及事实表.

blocks.en: 2.5 Scoring System
blocks.zh: 2.5 分红系统

blocks.en: All solutions were evaluated using the following metrics:
blocks.zh: 使用下列衡量标准对所有解决方案进行了评估:

blocks.en: • Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) measuring fidelity score, • Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) as proxy for perceptual score, • Mean Opinion Score (MOS) obtained from a user study and used to evaluate the perceived aesthetic quality of the enhanced images, • The runtime on the target Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 and Dimensity 9500 GPU.
blocks.zh: · 峰值信号对噪声比(PSNR)测量忠诚度分数, 结构相近指数度量(SSIM)作为知觉分数的代名词, 由用户研究获得并用来评价增强图像的感知美学质量, 目标Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5和 Dimensity 9500 GPU的运行时间。

blocks.en: Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) measuring fidelity score,
blocks.zh: 峰值信号对噪比(PSNR)测量忠诚度分数,

blocks.en: Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) as proxy for perceptual score,
blocks.zh: 结构相似性指数度量(SSIM)作为知觉分数的代名词,

blocks.en: Mean Opinion Score (MOS) obtained from a user study and used to evaluate the perceived aesthetic quality of the enhanced images,
blocks.zh: 通过用户研究获得的《平均意见分数》,用于评价增强图像的审美质量,

blocks.en: The runtime on the target Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 and Dimensity 9500 GPU.
blocks.zh: 目标Snapdragon 8精英Gen 和 Dimensity 9500 GPU的运行时间.

blocks.en: The score of each final submission was evaluated based on the next formula ( C C is a constant normalization factor):
blocks.zh: 根据下一个公式(CC是一个常态化系数)评价了每份最后划界案的分数:

blocks.en: Final Score = 2 2 ⋅ (PSNR + MOS) C ⋅ runtime , \text{Final Score}\,=\,\frac{2^{2\cdot\text{(PSNR + MOS)}}}{C\cdot\text{runtime}},

During the final challenge phase, the participants did not have access to the test dataset. Instead, they had to submit their final TensorFlow Lite models that were subsequently used by the challenge organizers to check both the runtime and the fidelity results of each submission under identical conditions. This approach solved all the issues related to model overfitting, reproducibility of the results, and consistency of the obtained runtime / accuracy values.
blocks.zh: 在最后的挑战阶段,参与者无法访问测试数据集。 相反,他们必须提交最后的TensorFlow Lite模型,这些模型随后被挑战组织者用来检查每次提交在相同条件下的运行时间和忠诚结果。 这种方法解决了与模型过度调整、结果的可复制性以及获得的运行时间/准确值的一致性有关的所有问题。

blocks.en: 3 Challenge Results
blocks.zh: 3 挑战结果

blocks.en: In this challenge, 6 teams entered the final phase and submitted their results, TFLite models, codes, executables and factsheets. Table 1 summarizes the final challenge results for both tracks and report PSNR, SSIM and runtime numbers for the valid solutions on the final test dataset and on the target evaluation platform. The proposed methods are described in section 4 , and the team members and affiliations are listed in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 在这个挑战中,有6支队伍进入了最后阶段并提交了结果,TFLite模型,代码,可执行文件以及事实表. 表1总结了在最后测试数据集和目标评价平台上有效解决方案的轨道和报告PSNR、SSIM和运行时间数字的最后挑战结果。 第4节介绍了拟议方法,附录A列出了小组成员和隶属关系。

blocks.en: 3.1 Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 3.1 结果和讨论

blocks.en: Almost all submitted solutions demonstrated very high efficiency: the majority of models are able to process one Full HD resolution (1920 × \times 1088 px) image under 300 ms on the target mobile GPUs. Team DaHua-IIG is the challenge winner: it achieved both the best perceptual image reconstruction results and an exceptionally good runtime of 23.8 ms and 60.4 ms on the Adreno and Arm GPUs, respectively. This team used a knowledge distillation strategy to overcome the misalignment of the input-target image pairs and trained a relatively shallow student CNN model for actual on-device inference. Several teams used ideas and blocks from transformer architectures in this challenge, however, despite their efficiency, they also significantly increased the latency of the resulting models.
blocks.zh: 几乎所有被提交的解决方案都表现出非常高的效率:大多数模型都能在目标移动GPU上在300ms下处理出一个完整的HD分辨率(1920×\times 1088px)图像. Team DaHua-IIG是挑战取胜者:它既实现了最佳的感知影像重建结果,也取得了Adreno和Arm GPU上分别为23.8 ms和60.4 ms的异常好运行时间. 这个团队使用知识分馏策略来克服输入-目标图像对等的错配,并训练了一个相对浅的有线电视新闻网学生模型,用于实际的对等推论. 一些团队在这一挑战中使用了变压器架构中的想法和块块,然而,尽管效率很高,它们也大大增加了由此产生的模型的耐用性.

blocks.en: A notable progress that should be highlighted is the ease of model conversion to the target TFLite format. Table 1 shows that the majority of solutions in this challenge were developed using the PyTorch ML framework. Due to the recently presented litert-torch plugin 4 4 4 https://github.com/google-ai-edge/litert-torch developed by the LiteRT team, one can now directly convert the majority of PyTorch models to the TFLite format without the need for TensorFlow / Keras model re-implementation or use of ONNX as an intermediary format. This significantly simplifies the development process of mobile-friendly deep learning architectures for the majority of researchers using PyTorch as their main framework for AI model development and training.
blocks.zh: 应当强调的一个显著进展是模式转换为目标TFLite格式的容易。 表1显示,这一挑战的大多数解决方案都是使用PyTorch ML框架制定的。 由于Litert-torch插件4 4 4 https://github.com/google-ai-edge/litert-torch 由LitERT团队开发,现在人们可以直接将大多数PyTorch模型转换为TFLite格式而无需TensorFlow / Keras模型重用或使用ONNX作为中间格式. 这大大简化了大多数以PyTorch为主要框架的研究人员的移动友好型深层学习架构的开发过程.

blocks.en: 4 Challenge Methods
blocks.zh: 4. 挑战方法

blocks.en: This section describes solutions submitted by top teams participating in the final stage of the MAI 2026 RGB Image Enhancement challenge.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍参加MAI 2026 RGB图像增强挑战决赛阶段的顶级团队提交的解决方案.

blocks.en: 4.1 DaHua-IIG
blocks.zh: 4.1 达瓦-IIG

blocks.en: Figure 3 : DENet architecture proposed by team DaHua-IIG
blocks.zh: 图3:DaHua-IIG团队提出的DENet架构

blocks.en: Team DaHua-IIG proposed the DENet architecture illustrated in Figure 3 . Since the input and ground-truth image pairs in the DPED dataset are not always perfectly aligned at the pixel level, the authors first trained a teacher model on this dataset with strong representational capacity, and then used the outputs of this model as pseudo ground truth for the student model [ 17 ] . Through this distillation strategy they were able to achieve a favorable trade-off between the enhancement quality and computational efficiency of the student model.
blocks.zh: DaHua-IIG团队提出了图3所示的DENet架构。 由于DPED数据集中的输入和地上真像对不总是像素级的完全对齐,作者首先在这个数据集上培训了一个具有强烈代表能力的教师模型,然后将这个模型的输出作为学生模型的伪地真象[17]. 通过这一分馏战略,他们得以在学生模型的提高质量和计算效率之间实现有利的取舍。

blocks.en: For the teacher model, the authors adopted the RetinexFormer [ 9 ] model that effectively integrates the Retinex theory with a transformer-based architecture. It achieves the state-of-the-art performance in low-light image enhancement, excelling in detail recovery and color fidelity, making it well-suited for the sRGB image enhancement task. As shown in Figure 3 , the student model is derived from a modified version of the PLUnet [ 38 ] — the winning method in the 2025 sRGB image enhancement challenge, known for its outstanding performance in this domain. The authors added two specific modifications to the PLUnet. First, to further reduce the inference time, one FCBlock was removed from the original architecture. Second, the authors applied channel pruning to decrease the model’s computational complexity, making it more suitable for practical deployment.
blocks.zh: 对于师范模型,作者采用了RetinexFormer[9]模型,将Retinex理论与以变压器为主的建筑有效融合. 它在低光图像增强中实现了最先进的性能,在细节恢复和色彩忠实方面表现优异,使它非常适合SRGB图像增强任务. 如图3所示,学生模式出自PLUnet [38]的修改后版本——2025 sRGB图像增强挑战中的取胜方法,以在这一领域的出色表现而出名. 提交人对PLUnet增加了两项具体的修改。 首先,为进一步缩短推论时间,从原建筑中移除了1个FCBlock. 第二,作者应用了频道搜索以减少模型的计算复杂性,使其更适合实际部署。

blocks.en:
During the training of both the teacher and student models, the authors employed a combination of Multi-Scale L 2 L_{2} loss, Multi-Scale Structural Similarity (MS-SSIM) loss, and VGG-19-based Content loss. The Multi-Scale L 2 L_{2} loss was defined as: ℒ M ​ S ​ M ​ S ​ E ​ ( X , Y ) = ∑ i ℒ M ​ S ​ E ​ ( X i , Y i ) , \mathcal{L}_{MSMSE}\left(X,Y\right)=\sum_{i}{\mathcal{L}_{MSE}\left(X_{i},Y_{i}\right)}, ℒ M ​ S ​ E ​ ( X , Y ) = ∥ X − Y ∥ 2 2 , \mathcal{L}_{MSE}\left(X,Y\right)=\lVert X-Y\rVert_{2}^{2}, where X i X_{i} and Y i Y_{i} are the representations of the image pair at different bilinear sampling scales i ∈ i\in [1, 0.5, 0.25].
For the teacher model, the weighting factors for these three losses were set to 1, 500, and 1, respectively. For the student model, the corresponding weights were 1, 400, and 10.

blocks.en: The parameters of the teacher model were optimized using the Adam optimizer ( β 1 \beta_{1} = 0.9 and β 2 \beta_{2} = 0.999) with a batch size of 32. The learning rate was initially set to 2 × \times 10 − 4 10^{-4} and then gradually reduced to 1 × 10 − 6 \times 10^{-6} by the cosine annealing scheme after 1000000 iterations. For training the student model, the batch size was set to 96, and the learning rate was initially set to 1 × 10 − 3 \times 10^{-3} .
4.2 Capybara
blocks.zh: 4.2 卡比巴拉岛

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Model architecture proposed by team Capybara
blocks.zh: 图4:Cabybara团队提出的模式架构

blocks.en: Team Capybara proposed a hybrid architecture consisting of a lightweight gated multi-scale encoder-decoder and a set of UNet-style refinement blocks (Fig. 4 ). The encoder-decoder branch provides efficient feature extraction, whereas the refinement blocks improve detail reconstruction, color restoration, and structural consistency at multiple spatial scales [ 77 ] .
blocks.zh: Team Capybara提出了由轻量级闸门多级编码器和一组UNet型的完善块(图4)组成的混合结构. 编码器-解码器分支提供高效的地物提取,而精细块则在多空间尺度上改进了细节重建,色彩恢复和结构一致性[77].

blocks.en: The training objective is defined as a weighted combination of three loss functions: 1) a PSNR-based loss that is computed on the luminance channel Y in order to emphasize perceptual brightness fidelity; 2) MS-SSIM loss, and 3) OutlierAwareLoss used to reweight pixel-wise errors according to per-image deviation statistics, thereby assigning greater emphasis to more challenging regions.
blocks.zh: 培训目标的定义是三种损失功能的加权组合: (1) 基于PSNR的损失,在亮度通道Y上计算,以强调感知的亮度忠诚;(2) MS-SSIM损失;和(3) Outlier 知識Loss曾根据每幅图像偏差统计重新加权像素偏差误差,从而更强调更具挑战性的区域.

blocks.en: The model was implemented in PyTorch Lightning, its parameters were optimized using Adam with a learning rate of 10e–4. For scheduling, cosine annealing with warm restarts was adopted.
blocks.zh: 该模型被应用于PyTorch Lightning,其参数被优化使用Adam,学习率为10e–4. 在时间安排方面,采用了带有温暖重启的余弦反射.

blocks.en: 4.3 Mivlab
blocks.zh: 4.3 米夫拉布语

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Enhanceformer model proposed by team Mivlab
blocks.zh: 图5:Mivlab小组提出的增强型模式

blocks.en: Team Mivlab presented the Enhanceformer model which architecture is demonstrated in Figure 5 . It adopts a 4-level encoder-decoder U-Net like architecture that uses transformer blocks and transposed attention modules to reduce the number of parameters and the model’s computational complexity. From level 1 to level 4, the number of Integrated Transformer Blocks are [1, 1, 1, 2], the number of attention heads in IMTA are [1, 2, 4, 8], and the number of channels are [8, 16, 32, 64]. The refinement stage contains 1 blocks. The channel expansion factor in GDFN is γ = 2.66 \gamma=2.66 .
blocks.zh: Mivlab团队介绍了在图5中展示的增强型模型。 它采用4级编码器-解码器U-Net像架构,使用变压器块和移植的注意模块来减少参数数量和模型的计算复杂性. 从1级到4级,集成变形板块数量为[1,1,1,2],IMTA中的关注头数为[1、2,4,8],频道数量为[8,16,32,64]. 完善阶段包含1个街区. GDFN的信道扩展因子为γ=2.66\gamma=2.66.

blocks.en: The model was trained to minimize L 1 L_{1} loss with the AdamW optimizer ( β 1 \beta_{1} = 0.9, β 2 \beta_{2} = 0.999, weight decay 1e–4) for 510K iterations with the initial learning rate 3e–4 gradually reduced to 1e–6 with the cosine annealing strategy. The model was trained on patches of size 128 × \times 128 with a batch size of 960. For data augmentation, the authors used horizontal and vertical flips.

blocks.en: 4.4 MotongAI
blocks.zh: 4.4 莫通加

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Model architecture proposed by team MotongAI
blocks.zh: 图6:莫通团队提出的模式架构. 大赦国际

blocks.en: Team MotongAI presented the Enhanceformer model which architecture is demonstrated in Figure 6 . Its design is also inspired by the Retinexformer [ 9 ] architecture. The model has a U-Net-like structure and consists of multiple Enhance Blocks and Content-Guided Fusion Block (CFB) processing the image at different scales. Each Enhance Block consists of a LayerNorm , a self-attention mechanism and an EMLP block. The CFB block effectively combines the extracted global information with the input features at both channel attention and spatial attention scales.
blocks.zh: 莫通队 大赦国际介绍了图6所示的增强型模型。 其设计还受了Retinexformer [9] 建筑的启发. 该模型有类似U-Net的结构,由多块增强块和内容引导融合块(CFB)组成,在不同尺度处理图像. 每个增强 块由LayleNorm,自留心机制和EMLP块组成. CFB块将提取出的全球信息与信道注意力和空间注意力尺度的输入功能有效结合.

blocks.en: The model was trained to minimize L 1 L_{1} loss using the Adam optimizer with β 1 \beta_{1} = 0.9, β 2 \beta_{2} = 0.99, and a batch size of 512. Cosine annealing learning rate scheduler was employed to control the variation of the learning rate. The initial learning rate was set to 1e–3, decreasing during the training to 5e–6.
blocks.zh: 该型号经过了培训,可以使用有β 1\β 1}=0.9,β 2\β 2\β2}=0.99 和512分批量大小的亚当优化器来将损失最小化. 使用了阴道反射学习率计时器来控制学习率的变化。 初始学习率定为1e-3,培训期间降至5e-6。
